verdict.rationale: Gitleaks-Action explicitly integrates into GitHub workflows and uses the GitHub API to post PR comments/reviews when secrets are detected, and it can also fail CI checks on findings; it's a well-documented first-party GitHub Action. Missing for 10: GitLab-specific MR comment/check integration is not evidenced (only GitHub is covered), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the PR-comment behavior beyond vendor docs.
